cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "There's a way to know before it happens. Costs money. Costs the right kind of money, mind, not the kind we're short of."

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "No." A pause, because he's noticed how that sounded. "Not because it's wrong. Because it's too soon."

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "You start with 'just this once' and you don't notice the year it stopped being once."

cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: A pause, then "Fine. We do it the hard way. For now"
Nobody writes it down, but it's agreed, the way things get agreed round here - once, out loud, and never mentioned again unless it stops holding.
